title.en: Fix the iPad and desktop language menu
title.zh: 修复 iPad 与桌面语言菜单

purpose.en: Prevent the GreatLoveMeta language dropdown from collapsing to its trigger width on iPad and desktop Safari while preserving site routing and branding.
purpose.zh: 防止 GreatLoveMeta 的语言下拉菜单在 iPad 与桌面 Safari 中被压缩为触发按钮宽度，同时保留本站路由与品牌。

en: Render the twelve-language desktop dropdown as a readable 330-pixel two-column overlay.
Keep the overlay bounded by the viewport and vertically scrollable on shorter screens.
zh: 将含十二种语言的桌面下拉菜单呈现为可读的 330 像素双栏浮层。
使浮层始终受视口边界约束，并在较矮屏幕上支持纵向滚动。

en: Shared public header language menu on localized public and member routes.
Deployment checks and Project release history.
zh: 本地化公共页面及会员路由所用的共享页头语言菜单。
部署检查与项目发布历史。

en: Override the generic container width cap for the absolute-positioned language overlay.
Add regression, production-asset, and exact Project-evidence checks for this release.
zh: 为绝对定位的语言浮层覆盖通用容器宽度上限。
为本次发布加入回归、生产资源与精确项目证据检查。

en: Language-menu layout regression and shared portfolio gates pass.
Production build and the complete repository test suite pass before publication.
Production serves the corrected CSS asset and Project evidence for the exact commit.
zh: 语言菜单布局回归与共享组合规门禁通过。
发布前通过生产构建和完整仓库测试套件。
生产环境提供修正后的 CSS 资源及精确 commit 的项目证据。

en: Realtime audio/video tests are intentionally not started because this release changes only shared-header layout and release tooling.
zh: 本次发布只修改共享页头布局与发布工具，因此明确不启动实时音视频测试。

en: Preserve GreatLoveMeta branding, locale routes, independent data, and cloud resources while adopting the canonical overlay containment fix.
zh: 采用规范浮层容纳修复时，保留 GreatLoveMeta 的品牌、本地化路由、独立数据与云资源。
